license: MIT, copyright Hust Visual Learning Team 2021
input: RGB uint8 NHWC 1x320x320, aspect-preserving letterbox 114; ImageNet mean/std embedded in RKNN
unused_output: YOLOP vehicle detector cropped out; human/vehicle detection retains M404 YOLOv8n
backend: RKNN/NPU FP16, toolkit2 2.3.2, system runtime 2.3.0, driver 0.9.8
postprocess: binary argmax; remove small/disconnected road components; model-paint row runs + curvature/gap limited tracks + quadratic curves; closest observed boundaries on both sides of assumed optical axis; perspective width, road support and temporal jump veto; no scene ROI
road_coordinates: letterbox crop -> normalized original-image coordinates; 320x180 masks for geometry -> native/preview coordinates
age_policy: latest-only worker; short hold explicitly labeled; expire 500ms; target relationship only if road+target ages<=250ms; reset on epoch
limitations: road behind occluders is not verified free space
optical axis assumes camera near lane-facing centre; not calibrated vehicle pose
320 input loses small/distant paint; intersections/weak/night/occluded boundaries may be unknown
